title: Sohatuys Drinks
description: Brew some more drinks in minecraft
body:
A [Let's Do] Vinery addon, that adds other drinks and types of drinks to minecraft. You can now brew rum, champagne, whiskey, armagnac, alkie, and other drinks.
Thanks for the original mod author, satisfyu.

**ITS A VINERY MOD ADDON, NOT AN ORIGINAL MOD!**
